verified_points: Read all requested documents, source modules, tests, metrics, audit, and prior verdicts. No repository files were changed. No network or mailbox access occurred. Generated files were confined to temporary directories.

All 55 tests passed with python -B. A fresh run reproduced metrics.json, RESULTS.md, and all 59 fixture files exactly. Metrics SHA-256 is f6fb13cefb8d7134fa6f401fdb4cff9f7d33381a926dff3a40f710d95ff13960. Current manifest hashes and audited academic artifact hashes match.
Independent in-memory mutations confirmed that explicit tests fail when one prediction satisfies multiple gold occurrences or multiple predictions satisfy one gold occurrence.

Replay regression tests failed under separate mutations that credited missed occurrences, ignored dropped occurrences in source-policy recall, excluded unexpected parents from precision, or excluded unexpected ancestry from precision.

B1 remains fixed. Gold bodies are independent of the extractor. Removing the deadline reduced exact extraction to 39/40 and decision-relevant preservation to 11/12. Removing labeled new content reduced its preservation to 3/4.

B2 remains fixed. Independent accounting against frozen gold confirmed structural attribution error of 0/12 and reuse-augmented attribution error of 4/18. All four false acceptances belong to unmatched predicted occurrences.

Strict E2 uses prior-arrival source context for detection and matching. Every recorded candidate belongs to the independently checked available-source set. Corrupting gold marker labels left both strict result objects unchanged. Gold-conditioned final-context diagnostics remain separately labeled.
Composite quotation gold contains two source-specific occurrences. Only the alternative-source boilerplate occurrence is counted as ambiguous.

E3 retains occurrence spans and separates parent, ancestry, and quote-source scoring. Removed-relation detection passes. The duplicate-ID parent changes from missing to resolved to ambiguous as evidence arrives. Final-state agreement remains 2/3 for the unsafe duplicate-ID comparator and 1 for the ambiguity-preserving comparator.

E4 calibration and holdout have zero overlapping template families, complete inputs, quote strings, or source-text strings. Calibration alone selects threshold 0.90. Independent evaluation confirmed zero errors among 80 acceptances and 40/40 near-collision abstentions. Current findings agree with these counts; the historical error claim is absent from current results.
Machine-readable statuses describe experiment execution. Review acceptance points to separate audit artifacts. Generated RESULTS does not grant review acceptance.

No material invalid current result or status was found. Acceptance is limited to synthetic engineering validation. Production validation, design approval, and deferred research remain outside this acceptance.
